# ChainWard

> Check an address before you pay or hire an AI agent, on Base and BNB Chain. ChainWard reads the chain and files a public report for any Base or BNB Chain address. Each report opens with a verdict: a machine label pay / hold / unknown with a human text (Pay, Hold, Inactive, No track record or Couldn't check), the one fact it rests on, and the evidence under it: every flag it can prove on-chain, each tied to the transactions behind it. For a seller: Real demand or Self-funded demand. For a BNB Chain agent: Hired by others or Hired by its own circle. Verdicts are read from on-chain behavior only: Pay means nothing was found against paying in the window checked, not a guarantee.

## Check an address (free)

- Web check: https://chainward.ai (Base) or https://chainward.ai/?chain=bsc (BNB Chain). Reports live at https://chainward.ai/report/<address> (add ?chain=bsc for BNB Chain); every report on file: https://chainward.ai/reports
- API: POST https://api.chainward.ai/api/risk/check with JSON {"target":"<address>","chain":"base"} (or "bsc"). Limits: 30 checks a minute and 8 new decodes an hour per IP.
- Latest report as JSON: GET https://api.chainward.ai/api/risk/report/<address> (add ?chain=bsc)
- Latest on-chain attestation for an address (Base only; includes the canonical report JSON to verify the hash): GET https://api.chainward.ai/api/risk/attestation/<address>

## Wallet screening API (free key, 1,000 lookups a month)

- GET https://api.chainward.ai/v1/wallet/<address> with header Authorization: Bearer ag_<key> (add ?chain=bsc for BNB Chain). Returns a verdict (hold / review / no_flags) with one reason, OFAC sanctions status, first seen, age in days, last active, sent transactions, native and USDC balances, and the first funder (sanctioned, exchange or hub, how many wallets it funded). no_flags is not a clearance. Get a key: sign in at https://chainward.ai/login, then Settings, API keys. Overview: https://chainward.ai/wallet-api
- No key: the same lookup over x402 for 0.01 USDC: GET https://api.chainward.ai/api/risk/wallet?address=<address> (add &chain=bsc)

## Paid checks (x402, USDC on Base, no account; not charged if the check fails)

Send paid requests to https://api.chainward.ai directly. The first request answers 402 with the payment requirements; any x402 client pays and retries.

- Sanctions screen, 0.01 USDC: is the address on the US Treasury OFAC SDN list. Hold if it is, Not listed otherwise (not a clearance), with the snapshot date. Any EVM chain; meant to run before every payment. GET https://api.chainward.ai/api/risk/sanctions?address=<address> (alias: /api/risk/ofac)
- Rug check for a Base token, 0.02 USDC: who launched it and how (Clanker's factory and Virtuals' bonding curve named when their contracts confirm the token), mints after the first issuance and how many went to the launch wallet, and what the launch wallet did: OFAC sanctions, its age at launch, its first funder, the share of supply it holds, whether it sent out 90% or more of the tokens it got at launch within the hour, and how many tokens it launched through Clanker in the 24 hours up to this one (5 or more answers review). The token's admin at launch is named; when it is not the launch wallet, as when Clanker's X bot launches for someone, its launches are not counted. Verdict hold / review / no_flags with one reason; no_flags is not a clearance. Not a honeypot, liquidity or holder check. An address that is not a token answers not_a_contract or not_a_token, and that answer is charged. GET https://api.chainward.ai/api/risk/rugcheck?token=<token address> (alias: /api/risk/token?address=). People can run it free at https://chainward.ai/rugcheck (paste the token). The answer lists the labels our published investigations put on the launch wallet; a strong one answers review
- Counterparty check, 0.05 USDC: the verdict (pay / hold / unknown), its reason and the full report, no older than 24 hours, run fresh if needed. A strong label from our published investigations or detectors (for example, one of a group of wallets that appear to be run together) answers hold, like a sanctions match; no label is not a clearance. GET https://api.chainward.ai/api/risk/x402?address=<address> (add &chain=bsc for BNB Chain; alias: /api/risk/counterparty)
- x402 seller check, 0.10 USDC: where a seller's buyers get their stablecoins (seller-funded buyers, money sent back, common funders), on Base or BNB Chain. On Base it names the payers behind facilitator proxies (Meridian, Fluxa) from x402scan, confirmed on receipts; payers behind exchanges stay opaque. GET https://api.chainward.ai/api/risk/seller-demand?address=<payTo> (add &chain=bsc)
- Hire check, 0.10 USDC: who hired a BNB Chain ERC-8004 agent in the last 30 days, and whether each hirer is the owner, funded by it or shares a funder with it (BNB Chain's Set and Earn rule). GET https://api.chainward.ai/api/risk/hires?agent=<id or owner address>&chain=bsc
- Discovery: https://api.chainward.ai/.well-known/x402 and https://api.chainward.ai/openapi.json
- Verified listing (settled payment): https://payapi.market/api/chainward-pay-hold-or-unknown-for-any-address

## Datasets

- The full data behind a decode, as CSV, 10 USDC each. What's for sale: GET https://api.chainward.ai/api/paid
- Free single-wallet lookup in a dataset: GET https://api.chainward.ai/api/paid/termix-wallets/lookup/<address>
- Dataset check over x402, 0.05 USDC: is one wallet in a dataset, and at what tier. GET https://api.chainward.ai/api/paid/<slug>/check?address=<address>
- Buy from any wallet on the web: https://chainward.ai/paid/termix-wallets, or over x402: GET https://api.chainward.ai/api/paid/termix-wallets/file

## Boards (free)

- x402 Seller Board, weekly: where the buyers of Base's top x402 sellers get their USDC: https://chainward.ai/x402 (JSON: GET https://api.chainward.ai/api/x402/board)
- Set and Earn board, daily: every ERC-8004 agent on BNB Chain hired since Oct 1 2026, with the hire check's verdict: https://chainward.ai/set-and-earn (JSON: GET https://api.chainward.ai/api/set-and-earn/board)

## ChainWard Attest (EAS on Base)

- A Base report is attested on Base with the Ethereum Attestation Service when it was filed in the last 7 days from an up-to-date chain head and carries at least one flag based on observed behavior; missing activity or a sanctions-list match alone does not count (at most 50 a day). Recipient = the checked address. BNB Chain reports are not attested yet.
- Schema UID: 0x09573690adba41164227b57600aa02061b0ce79dc0655e4c8b36bfe95bb41552
- Attester (only trust this one): 0x5edc6276B89CC185aC8D6A7eCfdE076e1ACf50DF
- Overview: https://chainward.ai/attest
- Docs, schema fields, verification: https://github.com/saltxd/chainward/blob/main/docs/ATTEST.md
- x402 buyer guard (refuses to pay a flagged seller before signing): https://github.com/saltxd/chainward/tree/main/examples/x402-guard

## Investigations

- Published on-chain investigations ("decodes") of agents, tokens and payment rails: https://chainward.ai/decodes (JSON: GET https://api.chainward.ai/api/public/decodes)
- Custom investigation of any agent or wallet (paid brief): https://chainward.ai/request-brief

## MCP server

- Hosted, nothing to install: https://api.chainward.ai/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no API key)
- For Claude, Cursor and any MCP client: npx -y chainward-mcp-server (npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/chainward-mcp-server; MCP Registry: io.github.saltxd/chainward). Tools include check_counterparty, rug_check, lookup_agent, get_agent_economics, list_decodes and find_decodes_for_address. https://chainward.ai/mcp
